After the battle, she continued to contribute greatly to the development of science and technology in Fifrecia, and became a well-known figure in the country. After acquiring vast wealth, she established her own laboratory, where she conducts research day and night. Her race is dark elf, but since it is met with surprise that a dark elf is a scientist, she has stopped revealing her race. Naturally, she never had children, so when she created Meena, she said: [b]"I will create the best maid there ever was!"[/b]

She and her daughter, Meena, are like a usual mother and daughter, but also like a master and servant, and they have an immense relationship of trust. Meena calls Parthia "Mother" and believes that she is always right, and Parthia has an extraordinary interest in the DNA of the protagonist, a visitor from another world, and orders Meena to collect his semen at any cost.
